name: Spearmint
description: A fresh, cool-smelling herb with bright-green toothed leaves. It grows fast and spreads everywhere if you let it.

image.alt: Fresh spearmint leaves with jagged edges

uses.title: Tea
uses.text: Fresh leaves in hot water make a simple mint tea.

uses.title: Kitchen
uses.text: Lemonade, salads, yoghurt sauces and new potatoes.

uses.title: Garden
uses.text: Bees and butterflies visit its small purple flowers.

growingTips.title: Pot
growingTips.text: Grow it in a pot, because its roots spread under the ground.

growingTips.title: Light
growingTips.text: Sun or part shade both work.

growingTips.title: Water
growingTips.text: Keep the soil moist; mint does not like to dry out.

growingTips.title: Cutting
growingTips.text: Cut it back often to get fresh, tender leaves.
